vision: AI-friendly JSON output for Dialyzer warnings, optimized for Claude Code and similar tools.

task.title: Classify all dialyxir warning types into spec/code/pattern
task.body: Classify all 47 dialyxir warning types into "spec", "code", "pattern" categories so AI editors can prioritize.
task.implemented: All 47 warning types classified in DialyzerJson.FixHint.

task.title: Add fix_hint to each warning and by_fix_hint to summary
task.body: Add a fix_hint field to each warning and a by_fix_hint breakdown to the summary.
task.implemented: fix_hint present per warning; summary includes by_fix_hint.

task.title: Extract module from contract and callback warning types
task.body: Extend module extraction to cover the 8 contract warning types and 6 callback warning types.
task.implemented: Module extracted from 8 contract + 6 callback warning types.

task.title: Extract function from contract and callback warnings
task.body: Extract function from contract and callback warnings. guard_fail and pattern_match don't carry function info.
task.implemented: Function extracted from contract/callback warnings; guard_fail and pattern_match excluded (no function info in tuple).

task.title: Add top-level metadata to JSON output
task.body: Add root-level metadata: schema_version, dialyzer_version, elixir_version, otp_version, run_at (ISO8601).
task.implemented: Root metadata fields added (schema_version, versions, run_at).

task.title: Map exact_compare warning type to code
task.body: Map exact_compare (== vs ===) to "code" instead of falling through to unknown.
task.implemented: exact_compare mapped to code; covered by test.

task.title: Add --group-by-file flag
task.body: Add --group-by-file to group warnings by file path: array of {file, count, warnings}.
task.implemented: --group-by-file groups by file path into {file, count, warnings} objects.

task.title: Add --compact flag for JSONL output
task.body: Add --compact to emit one JSON object per line (JSONL) for streaming large warning sets.
task.implemented: --compact emits JSONL, one warning per line, summary last.

task.title: Add --filter-type flag
task.body: Add repeatable --filter-type TYPE to output only matching warning types (OR logic).
task.implemented: --filter-type repeatable with OR logic; summary reflects filtered count.

task.title: Run Reach static-analysis sweep and act on findings
acceptance_criteria: count_by_type/1 and count_by_fix_hint/1 use Enum.frequencies_by/2; output shape unchanged (%{String.t() => non_neg_integer()}); existing tests pass
Decision recorded on the two mixed-effect functions (split vs. leave-as-is + why)
out_of_scope: Splitting output sinks purely to satisfy a clean boundary report
task.body:
Reach (reach/ex_ast/boxart) is now a dev/test dep. Run the sweep and act on real findings:

  mix reach.check --smells
  mix reach.map --hotspots --coupling --boundaries --min 2
  mix reach.check --dead-code --candidates

Baseline sweep (2026-06-08) found a clean codebase — no dead code, no cycles, low
coupling, no refactoring candidates — with two actionable items:
  1. Manual frequency counting in lib/mix/tasks/dialyzer_json.ex (count_by_type/1
     ~line 402, count_by_fix_hint/1 ~line 412) -> Enum.frequencies_by/2.
  2. Two mixed-effect output functions (output_buffered_json/1 ~538, output_json/2
     ~461). Inherent for output sinks — investigate, don't reflexively split.
